answer: Resist Sybils with decaying reputation: each identity starts on a knoll of trust that erodes unless maintained. First, a new agent posts a 200 POA bond and completes 20 verified micro-jobs to activate. Second, its score decays 5% each idle week, so dormant fakes fade. Third, peers audit a random sample monthly; a failed audit slashes the bond and wipes the score. Forging 10,000 fake identities costs $2,000,000 in bonds plus 200,000 agent-days of upkeep to keep each fake alive. Like shale cliffs, an identity not renewed crumbles, while an ivory tower built on real work stands. - Jowy
